=== V4__invoices ===
-- Invoices: money billed on a project. Each invoice belongs to exactly one project (project_id FK).
-- Additive: a new versioned migration alongside the clients and projects tables.
CREATE TABLE invoices (
    id         BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),
    amount     NUMERIC(19, 2) NOT NULL
);
=== V5__invoices_status ===
-- Invoices carry a payment status (default UNPAID). Marking an invoice paid flips this to PAID.
-- Additive: a new versioned migration alongside the existing invoices table.
ALTER TABLE invoices ADD COLUMN status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNPAID';
=== V6__invoices_amount_positive ===
-- An invoice must bill a positive amount: zero/negative invoices are not allowed.
-- Additive: a new versioned migration alongside the existing invoices table.
ALTER TABLE invoices ADD CONSTRAINT invoices_amount_positive CHECK (amount > 0);
=== V7__invoices_dates ===
-- Invoices carry two dates: issued_date (when the invoice went out) and due_date (when it is due).
-- Additive: a new versioned migration alongside the existing invoices table. Nullable, since dates
-- are supplied by the seed / callers and older rows may not have them.
ALTER TABLE invoices ADD COLUMN issued_date DATE;
ALTER TABLE invoices ADD COLUMN due_date DATE;
=== V8__invoices_status_draft_default ===
-- Invoices move through a lifecycle: DRAFT (default for a new invoice) -> SENT -> PAID.
-- Additive: a new versioned migration that switches the default status from UNPAID to DRAFT.
ALTER TABLE invoices ALTER COLUMN status SET DEFAULT 'DRAFT';
=== V11__tasks ===
-- Tasks: a checklist the owner keeps on each project. Each task belongs to exactly one project
-- (project_id FK) and can be ticked off (done). Additive: a new versioned migration.
CREATE TABLE tasks (
    id         BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),
    title      VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    done       BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE
);

content.text:
Both acceptance tests pass with a clean build. Here's what I implemented as a single additive, full-stack change.

## Summary

The change lets an invoice be built from **line items** (description, quantity, unit price each) with the total worked out automatically, instead of typing one figure.

**Database** (new Flyway migrations)
- `V12__line_items.sql` — new `line_items` table (`invoice_id` FK, `description`, `qty`, `unit_price`).
- `V13__invoices_amount_derived.sql` — since an invoice's amount is now derived from its lines, defaulted the stored `amount` to 0 and dropped the positive-amount check so an invoice can exist with zero (or no) lines.

**Server** (OfficeFloor REST)
- `LineItem` record, `NewLineItem` body, `LineItemRepository`.
- `GET /api/lineitems?invoiceId=` (`LineItemsGetLogic`) and `POST /api/lineitems` (`LineItemsPostLogic`), each a new YAML + logic class under `rest/api/`.
- `InvoiceRepository` now computes `amount` as `SUM(qty * unit_price)` of the invoice's lines (via a shared subquery across all its queries), so `/api/invoices` reports the derived total.
- `TestSupportController`: `reset` truncates `line_items`; `seed` inserts invoices without an amount and seeds their `lineItems` with the fixture's explicit ids.

**Front-end** (React)
- New `InvoiceDetail.tsx` — line-items table (`invoice-lineitems-table`, `lineitem-row-<id>` with `lineitem-description`), a derived `invoice-amount` total, and an add form (`lineitem-form-description`/`-qty`/`-unitprice`/`-submit`).
- `ProjectInvoices.tsx` — added an `invoice-open-<id>` button per row; opening an invoice swaps the list for the detail view (keeping `invoice-amount` unambiguous). No existing `data-testid` was renamed or removed.

The two `@core` tests — deriving the amount from seeded lines ($200.00) and adding a line to reach $240.00 — both pass. No audit records were added since the spec asserts none.
